prototypeScope: V1.29 delta package: one White plate with the A7Z roof saddle body and lid (D-022). Nothing in the printed set is replaced; the V1.17 A7Z head clip (clip_cap) is no longer used (the head keeps its cap; the camera face is reprinted later for the USB camera).
knownFitBoundary: Board posts take M2 x 4 self-tapping into 1.6 mm pilots (dia 2.2 board holes +0.3); the floor underside is a 1.6 mm normal offset of the ray-cast shell roof with 0.3 mm clearance, printed on support (rough side down); the roof screws S-shell_pack-01/02 become M2 x 10 through the saddle floor into the pack shoulder bar (pilot drilled 0.3 mm deeper). Fan 30 x 30 x 8 held by the lid pocket bars; USB camera plug notch 12 x 10 mm at the front wall. Printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: V1.17 White overrides kept: 3 support interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer; the saddle body stands on tree support over its whole underside.

parts.poseOrigin: a7z-saddle/build_saddle.py world frame as printed: open side up, the domed floor underside (it follows the shell roof, 1.6 mm normal offset) on the bed. One rear corner touches (2.3 mm2, tip angle -55 deg); the whole underside stands on tree support (shells pattern of PRINT-ORIENTATION-PRACTICE.md: dome on the bed, support under the dome keeps every post and pilot end clean). Board posts and pilots, roof-screw seats and holes, lid-screw bosses and side slots print vertical. Flank-down rejected: the far flank becomes a 40 x 36 mm ceiling on 65 mm of tree support inside the box with every pilot horizontal; open side down rejected: support trapped under the floor.
